data.name: Manaqib
data.gender_notes: Manaqib is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Manaqib is derived from the Arabic word 'manaqib' which means 'praises' or 'eulogies'. It is a name that is often given to a child as a mark of respect and honor, reflecting the admirable qualities and achievements of their ancestors. The name Manaqib carries the meaning “Praises, Eulogies” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Manaqib usually hope their child will grow to embody praises, eulogies and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Manaqib holds deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture. It is believed to invoke the blessings of Allah and the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and to encourage the child to live a virtuous and honorable life, striving for excellence and eulogizing the virtues of Allah and His Messenger.
data.etymology: Manaqib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praises, Eulogies.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manaqib total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: مناقب
in_urdu.meaning: مناقب: نبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے احکام اور خبریں
